name: Covenant Of Grace
overview: The Covenant of Grace, as revealed in Scripture, is God's promise to establish a new covenant with His people, fulfilling the promise made to Abraham that all nations would be blessed through faith (Jeremiah 31:31; Galatians 3:8). This covenant, confirmed in Christ before the giving of the law, supersedes the old testament and guarantees the promise of salvation through Jesus, who serves as the mediator and surety of this better testament (Galatians 3:17; Hebrews 7:22; 9:15). Through His death, believers are redeemed from transgressions under the first covenant and receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
